allowedSourceMaterial.overview: El Mariachi just wants to play his guitar and carry on the family tradition. Unfortunately, the town he tries to find work in has another visitor, a killer who carries his guns in a guitar case. The drug lord and his henchmen mistake el Mariachi for the killer, Azul, and chase him around town trying to kill him and get his guitar case.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With a ruthless drug lord's hit squad hunting him across town, how long can an innocent musician survive a lethal manhunt meant for a killer?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Hoping to carry on his family's musical trade, an itinerant mariachi arrives in a Mexican border town seeking work, only to be mistaken for an armed hitman carrying weapons in an identical guitar case.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful action with moderate stakes and a stripped-down, gritty border-town atmosphere.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Clocking in at a breathless 81 minutes, Robert Rodriguez's action thriller delivers pure kinetic momentum, turning a simple case of mistaken identity into a taut, dusty chase.
